translations.web: Who has worked and done it, calling the generations from the beginning? I, Yahweh, the first, and with the last, I am he.”
translations.bsb: Who has performed this and carried it out, calling forth the generations from the beginning? I, the LORD—the first and the last— I am He.”
translations.kjv: Who hath wrought and done it, calling the generations from the beginning? I the LORD, the first, and with the last;
translations.asv: Who hath wrought and done it, calling the generations from the beginning? I, Jehovah, the first, and with the last, I am he.
